content.text: 'American Idol' 2026: Top 20 Contestants Revealed Amid Second Week of Aulani Resort RoundTonight is the final pre-taped episode of the season for American Idol, with live episodes scheduled to begin on March 30.The Top 20 contestants will continue to perform during the Disney’s Aulani Resort round for the episode airing on Monday, March 23 on ABC.Audiences now have a say in the competition, with voting happening on AmericanIdol.com/vote, through SMS text, or via social media commenting.The results of the voting from last week and this week will be announced during the live show on March 30.Browse through the slideshow to see who made it to the Top 20 this year on American Idol…...See full article at Just Jared3/23/2026by Just JaredJust JaredSimilar NewsAmerican IdolMariah Carey (56) Spotted Grocery Shopping — Fans Freak Out Over Her Fear of Bright Lights!3/26/2026by Valentina KraljikFiction HorizonInsiders Reveal How Much Taylor Frankie Paul Earned on Bachelorette3/26/2026by Josip KraljikFiction HorizonWho Is Pugcasso on 'The Masked Singer' Season 14?
